scope: Actual deterministic transcript and Frobenius support, 27 support theorems plus originalTarget identity; no unconditional statistical success.

actual_minimum_scan.definition: minimumIndex is the unchanged foldl over List.finRange(m+2) with initial0 and strict-score improvement.
actual_minimum_scan.argument: scan_le_initial/scan_le_member by list induction establish literal minimization, including ties and duplicate family members.
actual_minimum_scan.finite_nonempty_safeguard: Fin(m+2) is always nonempty; optimum uses that attained actual scan, not empty infimum or an arbitrary minimizer oracle.

full_branch.actual_transcript: Each right standard-basis query returns the exact corresponding A column; storedVector retrieves those actual responses and postprocess selects the actual finite-family minimum.
full_branch.actual_run_error: Exactly optimum A F for every stream whenever makePlan.full=true.
full_branch.Successful: Under n<=s+k+ell and epsilon>=0 the actual Successful event is literally Set.univ, GaussianLaw has mass1, and the 99/100 bound follows. No measurability or probability oracle is postulated.
full_branch.boundary: The dimension/width branch premise is explicit and does not prove the unconditional public successful export.

sketch_branch.literal_repair: Let b0=actual warm scan and Y=(A-Fb0)*G1; repair=Fb0+Y*pseudoInverse(H.transpose*Y)*(H.transpose*(A-Fb0)).
sketch_branch.helper_definition_safeguard: sketchWarmIndex and sketchRepair are proof-local conservative names. Their direct A arguments are linked back to the unchanged transcript-only postprocess by exact equality under P.full=false; the operational model is not replaced.
sketch_branch.pseudoInverse: Exactly the existing SVD-based model definition; no new arbitrary inverse or assumed rank oracle. These identities do not establish probabilistic full rank or reconstruction quality.

Frobenius_geometry.actual_norm: sqrt(sum real squared entry differences) equals Mathlib matrix norm under explicit Matrix.Norms.Frobenius scope, not another matrix norm.
Frobenius_geometry.nearest_family_bound: error(actual nearest candidate to X)<=OPT+2*frobenius(A,X) by two norm triangles and the literal finite scan.

conditional_transfer.explicit_repair_premise: repair_error<=(1+2eta)*OPT remains an explicit hypothesis of run_sketch_error_of_repair.
conditional_transfer.conclusion: error(run)<=(3+4eta)*OPT; eta is arbitrary real in this algebraic implication.

degenerate_cases: n=0 and arbitrary finite rectangular Frobenius dimensions
empty sketch blocks and exact stored-response offsets
zero OPT and zero repair error
arbitrary Plan/stream values: no Gaussian/rank/norm bound is hidden in deterministic claims
